attachmentContract.identity: The equipped appearance must remain recognizably the same exact item identity as the independently ACCEPTed Store art for that ID. A derivative may change background/transparency/crop for fit, but must preserve silhouette-defining form, materials, theme cues and distinctive construction.
attachmentContract.sourceLineage: Do not replace or alter the ACCEPTed JPG bytes. Any future try-on derivative must be versioned separately and record parent accepted Git blob SHA plus its own exact SHA-256/Git blob SHA, dimensions and bytes.
attachmentContract.alphaRequirement: The canonical Store replacements are JPEG paths and therefore cannot carry alpha. Do not simply point the avatar overlay at those opaque Store-card files. A true try-on implementation needs a transparent or otherwise avatar-safe derivative with explicit lineage, or an equivalent non-destructive masking path approved by 15.
attachmentContract.framing: Fit within the existing headwear overlay box without a visible card/studio rectangle, without clipping silhouette-defining parts, and without shrinking below card-readable recognition at the mobile 118x104 overlay size.
attachmentContract.occlusion: Do not cover the avatar eyes or smile. Headwear should visibly contact the hair/head rather than float. If an item semantically requires behind-hair depth, preserve the need as a layer requirement instead of faking it with a detached front-only placement.
attachmentContract.motion: No equip/hover motion may reveal hidden answers or celebrate wrong Quest states; accessory motion remains purely cosmetic and must retain reduced-motion compatibility if later implemented.

perItem.headwear-1: Headband: band must visibly wrap/contact the upper hairline/crown; preserve Midnight Neon identity and avoid a floating halo read.
perItem.headwear-2: Cloud Clips: clips must visibly attach to hair at plausible clip points and retain a clearly paired clip read where the accepted source shows multiple clips; keep face features unobstructed.
perItem.headwear-3: Pixel Cap: crown/brim must seat on the top of the head with a readable brim and no face occlusion below the eyebrow line; preserve Adventure Club construction cues.
perItem.headwear-4: Berry Bow: knot/attachment point must visibly contact hair/headwear support and the bow must remain recognizable at mobile overlay size; preserve Cloud Pop identity rather than treating it as a generic bow.
